list.title: List your place
list.subtitle: Rent out a private room or an entire property.
list.needAuth: Create an account or log in to publish a listing.
list.inquirySubtitle: We only publish rooms through approved RooMe agents — so seekers can trust what they see.
list.inquiryBody: Approved agents help us keep RooMe safe and accurate. Every listing is checked, details stay current, and people looking for a home are not left guessing.
list.inquiryReasonSafety: Safer for everyone. We confirm who is listing so seekers are not dealing with anonymous or fake posts.
list.inquiryReasonIntegrity: Better data. Agents verify rent, photos, and house rules before a room goes live.
list.inquiryReasonFresh: Kept up to date. When a room is taken or the price changes, an approved agent can update it right away.
list.inquiryCta: Call or send a WhatsApp message and we will help you get set up as an approved agent.
